 Oregon OC Jay Johnson has sparked the offense and helped save Oregon's slim Playoff hopes for a little while longer. What would he have to do in order to deserve the job in 2027?
 On this bonus episode of Locked On Ducks, Spencer McLaughlin breaks down a handful of potential OC candidates for Dan Lanning to consider. Wake Forest OC Rob Ezell is a highly interesting option. Plus, reacting to Oregon's latest ranking in the College Football Playoff.
